issue.title: test_chrome_layout resize nodes fail on clean HEAD (terminal resize has no effect)
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/ace/tui/command_line/test_chrome_layout.py::test_chrome_recomposes_and_stays_aligned_on_resize`

Two of the three `test_chrome_layout.py` resize nodes fail deterministically on a
clean tree; the third is intermittent (see below):

- `test_chrome_recomposes_and_stays_aligned_on_resize[wide0-narrow0]`: FAIL —
  `assert widths[0] == widths[2] > widths[1]` gets `134 > 134`; resizing the
  terminal to the narrow size has no effect.
- `test_frame_width_cap_and_full_height_toggle_keep_the_labels`: FAIL —
  `assert frame.outer_size.width == 96` gets `160`; the frame never shrinks after
  `resize_terminal(100, 40)`.
- `test_popup_reclamps_when_the_terminal_shrinks`: intermittent — failed in the
  full lane (`assert 34 < 34`, card x unchanged) but passed once on a clean-HEAD
  focused rerun.

No overlap with the monitor_failed_count_leak diff, which touches only
`src/sase/monitor_state.py`, `agent_session_members.py`,
`_agent_status_apply.py`, `agent_tribe_summary.py`, and
`_agent_display_clan_roster.py` — none of which the command-line chrome reads.

Observed at HEAD `eba6b80d0` during monitored `just check` run `5gky1hb2f6rp`
(tool run `f612c7e28035a677677bc1779111476b`).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduced on clean HEAD with the monitor_failed_count_leak diff stashed: focused pytest of the 3 nodes gives 2 deterministic failures (recomposes, frame_width_cap) with resize visibly not applied (widths stuck, card x unchanged). Not load timing.
